name: Go! Go! Purgatory!
source:
A young girl wakes up in the underworld. She is looking for a way to go back home. 
Help her to follow a virtuous path while she meets witty, charismatic characters. 
Meet George, the magic Hobo, even God himself and more. 

[From [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/ludum-dare-29/?action=preview&uid=21045]Ludum Dare[/url]]

Created for [url=http://www.ludumdare.com/compo/2014/04/23/welcome-to-ludum-dare-29er/]Ludum Dare 29[/url].
